description: A fictional hip-worn float bladder game prop, chunky low-poly, shown alone and inflated: a tall balloon on a short neck above a small belt pouch, like a light bulb standing on a belt. One wide charcoal webbing hip belt, a loop running round behind the pouch and closed at the weapon's right side by two thick rectangular charcoal buckle blocks, carries one small boxy sand-grey painted shell pouch with wide chamfers. One short thick charcoal neck rises from the pouch top. On it stands one tall smooth rounded bladder of matte sand-grey rubberised fabric, about 0.30 m across and 0.36 m tall, drawn as one smooth faceted volume, with exactly one wide charcoal band round it above its middle and one fat dark steel vent cap on its crown. On the pouch front one fat dark steel gas cartridge, a capsule with domed ends, lies sideways held in exactly two thick charcoal clips. One small teal lamp window in a thick charcoal bezel on the pouch front at its left end. The hidden back carries the belt loop.
proportions: About 0.24 m long, 0.46 m wide and 0.52 m tall. (length : width : height = 0.52 : 1 : 1.13)
sides: the float bladder is symmetric about its centre plane (x = 0) except the belt closure: the two rectangular charcoal buckle blocks of the belt are on the RIGHT flank (-x) at the pouch side, and the teal lamp window sits at the left end (+x) of the pouch front. Frame words: the FRONT is the pouch face with the sideways gas cartridge in two clips and the lamp window; the REAR is the back (the belt running round behind); the LEFT flank is the pouch side seen on the image right.
